- Monday 14:00-14:30
- Tuesday 11:10-11:40

If none of them suit you, tell me a time that does and I'll fit it in.

Best,
Sarah

Dear Sarah,

Monday 10:00-10:30 works — I've booked it. The other three clash: Monday 14:00-14:30 is free in itself but sits right before my 14:30 lecture, Tuesday 11:10-11:40 runs into my 11:30 lunch, and Wednesday 12:00-12:30 falls in my lunch hour.

So: **Monday 23 Nov, 10:00-10:30**, my office. Send me a short agenda beforehand if you can.

Best,
Professor Alvarez
